Package org.frc5411.lib.pattern.actuator.module

Class Module<Placement extends Enum<?>>

java.lang.Object
org.frc5411.lib.pattern.actuator.module.Module<Placement>
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable, Closeable, AutoCloseable, Actuator<edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.SwerveModuleState,edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.SwerveModulePosition>, Component<edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.SwerveModulePosition>
public abstract class Module<@NonNull Placement extends Enum<?>> extends Object implements Actuator<edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.SwerveModuleState,edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.SwerveModulePosition>

Module

Describes an abstract Swerve Module, i.e. any device that has one, a translational actuator and two, a rotational actuator, and can be commanded to a given reference of type state, and report back a position from measured values.

    • configure

      public abstract void configure()
      Force re-configures the underlying module hardware to the standard specifications of this type. Ideally, a blocking operation is also performed which ensures correct, hardware-safe application of relevant configurations before Module operation.

    • reset

      public void reset()
      Force resets this module's measurements to absolute heading measurements, may fix issues with offsets and relative positions. Should ideally not be called repeatedly or often.
